data.name: KartOne
data.detailed_description:
KartOne is a realistic racing game focused on karting. It delivers detailed driving physics, diverse track conditions and multiple game modes, allowing players to experience wheel-to-wheel competition in its purest form.

At this stage, our main focus is on kart physics and handling, to provide the most authentic feel of driving. In the future, we plan to introduce different motorsport classes – from rental karts to faster and more demanding racing machines.

The career mode will start with rental karts on smaller circuits, giving players the first step towards higher categories and professional competitions.

We are also in talks with motorsport brands. Our goal is to implement authentic licensed content – from clothing and trackside banners to kart liveries featuring real-world manufacturers. This will make the game world even more credible and closer to real racing events.

🎮 GAME MODES

  • Single Player: championships, races, qualifying, time trial, challenges.

  • Multiplayer: online and LAN racing with qualifying, practice sessions, split-screen (2–4 players). The game will also support dedicated servers to ensure stable and fair online competition.

  • Career: from rental karts to faster classes, with progression and unlockable content.

🏁 TRACKS AND CONDITIONS

  • Varied locations: indoor arenas, outdoor tracks and urban layouts.

  • Dynamic weather: rain, fog, night racing and changing track conditions.

  • Realistic racing mechanics: tire behavior and track contact simulated in a realistic way. Tire wear and fuel consumption directly affect performance and race strategy.

🔧 REALISM AND ACCESSIBILITY

  • Detailed kart physics model.

  • Simplified controls available for players who just want to enjoy the fun of driving.

Behind KartOne is a team of developers who have been passionate about karting for over a decade – with real track experience as well as long-term expertise in Unreal Engine. This combination allows us to bring together authentic motorsport knowledge and cutting-edge technology.

data.short_description: KartOne is a realistic racing game about karting, built in Unreal Engine 5. It focuses on authentic kart driving, career mode and multiplayer competition – from rental karts to high-performance racing classes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-8120
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 4GB, Radeon RX 460 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 8 GB, Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
